text: When we are in want we do not call all together, but only those that can best afford help in that particular case, when we would be advised, the wiser part; and when we are to have a trial the best pleaders; and when we are to go a journey, those that can live pleasantly and are at leisure.
author: Plutarch
locator: Symposiacs, Book V, Concerning Those That Invite Many to a Supper
